profile.company_profile: Bajaj Auto Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in the business of the development, manufacturing, and distribution of automobiles, such as motorcycles, commercial vehicles, electric vehicles, and parts. It is a manufacturer of two-wheelers, three-wheelers, and quadri-cycles. The Company sells its products in India as well as in various other global markets. Its segments include Automotive, Investments, and Financing. The Automotive segment includes all activities related to the development, design, manufacture, assembly, and sale of two-wheelers/three-wheelers as well as the sale of related parts and accessories. Its motorcycles include Boxer, CT, Platina, Discover, Pulsar, Avenger, KTM, Dominar, Husqvarna, and KTM. Its commercial vehicles include Passenger Carriers, Good Carriers, and Quadricycle. Its three-wheeler vehicles include GoGo, RE, Maxima Z, Maxima X Wide, and Maxima C. Its subsidiaries include Bajaj Auto Credit Ltd., Chetak Technology Ltd., and others.

profile.company_profile: Eicher Motors Limited is an India-based multinational automobile company. The Company is engaged in the manufacturing and selling of motorcycles, spare parts and related services. The Company primarily operates in the automotive segment. The automotive segment includes all activities related to development, design, manufacture, assembly and sale of two-wheelers as well as sale of related parts and accessories. Its flagship brand Royal Enfield, which is engaged in motorcycle business. Royal Enfield's motorcycle products include Interceptor 650, Continental GT 650, Classic, Bullet and Himalayan. Royal Enfield's portfolio also includes apparels and motorcycle accessories, including protective riding apparel, riding accessories, protective seats, bodywork, controls, wheels, luggage and engine. Its commercial vehicle business is led by VE Commercial Vehicles. Its joint venture with AB Volvo, VE Commercial Vehicles Limited (VECV), includes a range of Eicher branded trucks and buses.

profile.company_profile: TVS Motor Company Limited is an India-based two and three-wheeler manufacturer globally, supporting progress through sustainable mobility with four manufacturing facilities located in India and Indonesia. The Company's segments include Automotive Vehicles & Parts and Financial services. The Company manufactures a range of two-wheelers, starting from mopeds, to scooters, commuter motorcycles, and racing bikes like the TVS Apache series and the TVS Apache RR310. The Company's product categories include motorcycles, scooters, electric scooters, three wheelers and mopeds. Its motorcycle products include TVS Apache, Ronin, Raider, Radeon, Sport and Star City+. Its electric scooter products include TVS iQube and TVS X. The Company's scooter products include TVS Jupiter, TVS Jupiter 125, TVS Ntorq, TVS Zest 110 and others. Its services include book a service, annual maintenance contract, roadside assistance, TVS genuine parts and Tru4 Oil, and proactive inspection.

profile.company_profile: Hero MotoCorp Limited is an India-based two-wheeler manufacturing company. The Company is engaged in the manufacturing and selling of motorized two-wheelers, spare parts and related services. Its product category includes motorcycles, scooters, and parts. Its motorcycle products are XTREME 250R, XPULSE 210, GLAMOUR X, KARIZMA XMR, HF 100, XTREME 125R, SPLENDOR+, GLAMOUR XTEC, XTREME 160R 4V, MAVRICK 440, and others. Its scooter products include XOOM 160, Pleasure+ XTEC, XOOM, Destini PRIME, and NEW DESCTINI 125. Its accessories include Hero H1 Bluetooth helmet device, Smart Intercom Helmet Device, Tourer Magnetic Tank Bag, and Adventure Magnetic Tank Bag. The Company's electric vehicles are VIDA V2 PRO, VIDA V2 PLUS and VIDA V2 LITE. It also provides periodic maintenance for accidental repair with a range of parts, engine oil, and accessories. The Company's subsidiaries include HMCL Americas Inc. USA, HMCL Netherlands B.V., HMC MM Auto Limited, and Hero Tech Centre Germany GmbH.

profile.company_profile: Ather Energy Limited is an India-based pure play electric vehicle (EV) company. The Company specializes in Indian electric two-wheeler (E2W) market. The Company sells E2Ws and the associated product ecosystem, comprised of its software, charging infrastructure and smart accessories, all of which are conceptualized and designed by it in India. Its E2W portfolio comprises two product lines: the Ather 450 line, which caters to customers seeking performance scooters, and the Ather Rizta line, which is targeted at customers seeking convenience scooters for their family. The Company’s software, Atherstack, is developed in-house and powers all Ather products. Atherstack offers approximately 69 features related to navigation, analytics, ride assistance, safety and productivity, as well as integration with its charging infrastructure and smart accessories. Upon purchase of an E2W, its customers have the option to purchase advanced Atherstack software features through the Atherstack Pro.

profile.company_profile: Ola Electric Mobility Limited is an India-based electric vehicle (EV) company. The Company is engaged in building vertically integrated technology and manufacturing capabilities for EVs and EV components, including cells. It manufactures EVs and certain core EV components, such as battery packs, motors and vehicle frames at the Ola Futurefactory. Its segments include Automotive and Cell. The Automotive segment includes the sale of automobiles and related services. The Cell segment encompasses the sale of cells. The Company offers a range of products, such as Ola S1 Pro, Ola S1, Ola S1 Air, Ola S1 X+, Ola S1 X (2 kWh), and the Ola S1 X (3 kWh), in addition to the Ola S1 X+, as well as a line-up of motorcycles comprising four models, Diamondhead, Adventure, Roadster, and Cruiser. It also offers various accessories, such as Buddy Step Floor Mat and Scooter Cover combo, Buddy Step and Floor Mat combo, Floor Mat and Scooter Cover combo, Helmet, Portable Charger, and Portable Charger.

profile.company_profile: Tunwal E-Motors Ltd is an India-based electric two-wheeler manufacturing company. The Company specializes in design, development, manufacturing, and distribution of electric two-wheelers. It has approximately 23 different models, including seven variants of two-wheelers, which is launched in the domestic market catering to the various needs and segments. Its models include Lithino Pro Alfa Pro, Lithino Pro Lithino Pro Li, Roma Roma Li, TZ 3.3, TEM G33, Storm ZX Plus, T 133, and Mini Lithino Li 3.0. The Company has production facility strategically located in Palsana, Rajasthan.

profile.company_profile: Delta Autocorp Limited is an India-based company. The Company manufactures and sells 2W and 3W electric vehicles (EVs) using cutting edge components procured from original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) who use design and engineering specifications given by the Company. It supplies specific components designed and compatible for its vehicles. The Company operates under the brand name Deltic. It specializes in the production of electric 2W and 3W vehicles. Its product range encompasses electric scooters in the 2W category, along with electric rickshaws, electric loaders, and electric garbage carts in the 3W category, along with spare parts and accessories of 2W and 3W like motors, DC-DC Converter, Speedometer and others. Its line of 2W 3W and Spare and accessories include Deltic Drixx, Deltic Trento, Deltic ZGS, Deltic Legion, Deltic Star, Deltic Vayu, Deltic Vista and others. It works with more than 300 distribution networks spread across 25 states and the Union Territories of India.

profile.company_profile: Timken India Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in engineered bearings and industrial motion products. The Company is in the manufacture, distribution and sale of anti-friction bearings, primarily tapered roller bearings, other roller bearings, components, accessories, and mechanical power transmission products for a diverse customer base. It also provides maintenance contract and refurbishment services. The Company's manufacturing plants are located at Jamshedpur in Jharkhand & Bharuch in Gujarat and distribution centers are located in various parts of the country. Industrial motion products include augers, automatic lubrication systems, belts, brakes and clutches, chain, couplings & universal joints, gear drives / transmissions, linear motion, lubrication and lubrication systems, Timken maintenance tools, gearboxes overhaul, motor repair services, and up tower wind services. It offers various brands, such as Timken, Beka, Cone Drive, Diamond Drives and others.

Grindwell Norton Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in the manufacturing of abrasives, performance plastics and refractory products. The Company's segments include abrasives, ceramics and plastics, digital services, and others. The abrasives segment markets and manufactures a full range of bonded abrasives, coated abrasives (including non-woven abrasives), thin wheels and super abrasives. Its performance ceramics and refractories business makes ceramic and refractory products for a wide range of industrial applications. The products manufactured include silicon carbide based shaped refractory and ceramic products. Its performance plastics business produces and markets more than 800 standard and custom-made polymer products through three business divisions: engineered components, life sciences and composites. It provides various digital services, such as application development, infrastructure management, and cybersecurity to the Saint-Gobain group globally.

Carborundum Universal Limited is an India-based company, which manufactures and sells mainly abrasives, ceramics (industrial ceramics, refractories) and electro minerals. The Company's segments include Abrasives, Ceramics, Electrominerals, Power, IT Services and Others. Abrasive segment comprises of bonded, coated, processed cloth, polymers, power tools and coolants. Ceramics segment includes technical ceramics and super refractory solutions to address wear protection, corrosion resistance, electrical resistance, heat protection and ballistic protection. Electrominerals segment includes deals with the materials - fused aluminas, its variants, and silicon carbide - used in abrasives and refractories globally. The Company also provides information technology (IT) services, including IT infrastructure facility management services, software application development services and others. It has a manufacturing facility for phase change materials and specialty polymeric additives.

SKF India (Industrial) Limited is an India-based company. The Company is engaged in the business of manufacturing, trading, marketing and dealing with products, solutions and services within rolling bearing and, seals, rotating shaft services, and lubrication systems for the industrial sector, including railways, defense, wind energy, metal cement, mining, construction, material handling, pharma, chemical, food and beverage industry and others. It manufactures and sells a range of products and services, such as deep groove ball bearings, insert bearings (Y-Bearings) and self-aligning ball bearings (SABB), taper roller bearings, cylindrical roller bearings, spherical roller bearings of various designs and sizes. It also provides solutions like mounted bearings and housings, hybrid ceramic bearings and sensor bearings. It also offers remanufacturing bearings, spindle repair services, on-site condition monitoring services, roll-shop maintenance activities at customer sites.

SKF India Limited is an India-based company. The Company delivers advanced solutions for a wide range of automotive applications, including engines, transmissions, wheel-end systems, and steering mechanisms. The Company operates through Automotive division. It provides customized solutions for diverse requirements across wheelend, driveline, e-powertrain, engine, suspension, and steering systems-serving original equipment manufacturer (OEMs) across cars, light and heavy trucks, trailers, buses, and two-wheelers. It also supplies the vehicle aftermarket with spare parts, both directly and indirectly, through a network of over 321 distributors. Its offering around the rotating shaft includes bearings, seals, lubrication management, condition monitoring, and services. The Company's subsidiaries include Pilgrim International Limited, SKF Sealing Solutions Gmbh, SKF Economos India Pvt. Limited, SKF Argentina S.A, and others.

Wendt (India) Limited is an India-based manufacturer of super abrasives, high precision grinding, honing, special purpose machines and high precision components. The Company's segments include Super Abrasives, Machines and Accessories, and Precision Products. Its super abrasive products consist of diamond and cubic boron nitride (CBN) grinding wheels in various bonding systems, rotary dressers, stationary dressers, hones, and segmented products. Its machines include grinding machines, honing machines, profiling dressing machines and others. Its precision components include ferrous parts, non-ferrous precision parts, and others. Its star range of products includes single point dressers, natural point diamond dressers, chisel type dressers, cluster type dressers, multi-point indexable dressers, and others. Its allied products include machine refurbishing, accessories and equipment, finishing films and flaking. It serves various industries, including glass, steel, and aerospace.

SKP Bearing Industries Limited is an India-based company which is engaged in the manufacturing of needle rollers, cylindrical rollers, pins and steel balls and other related products, and the generation of electricity through windmill power projects and solar power projects. The Company’s business segment includes Manufacturing segment and Power Generation segment. Its manufacturing segment includes mulchand plant and zammar plant. Its Power Generation segment includes PM Kusum and other windmill and solar plant. Its products include needle rollers, cylindrical rollers, pins, balls and bearing types. The needle rollers products include Type BP (Flat Unground Ends), Type BR (Rounded Ends), and Type BPM (Flat Ground Ends). The steel ball products include G5 and G10 grade balls ranging from 5/32 inches to 7/8 inches. It also offers precision rollers and balls made from stainless steel, brass, aluminum, glass, and many more materials.

profile.company_profile: NRB Industrial Bearings Limited is a manufacturer of ball and roller bearings for the industrial market. It manufactures different bearing solutions for different applications. Its products include deep groove ball bearings, angular contact ball bearings, cylindrical roller bearings, spherical roller bearings, cam followers, bottom roller bearings, full complement needle roller bearings, and wide inner rings and housed units. Its deep groove ball bearings are robust, simple in design, non-separable, can support both radial and combined loads, and can be used in high-speed applications. Its deep groove ball bearings are available in three different variant sizes: 6000, 6200 and 6300. Its self-aligned ball bearings are a double row, self-retaining units comprising outer rings with concave raceway, inner rings with a cylindrical or tapered bore and ball and cage assemblies. It offers its standard assortment of cylindrical roller bearings in a steel cage in the N, NF, NJ, NU and NUP types.

Signpost India Limited is an India-based company. The Company is engaged in the business of advertising in general and outdoor advertising in various ways and manner, including indoor outdoor, newspapers, souvenirs, hoardings, buses, railways, bus shelters, airports and others. It provides out of home (OOH) media services focused on programmatic digital OOH advertising. Its array of media assets includes billboards: conventional, backlit and digital; transit: skywalks, bus panel, airports, metro, bus queue shelters and smart mobile vans, and other innovative: kiosks, traffic booths and public electric bicycle sharing. The Company has clients across multiple industries, such as consumer goods and services; banking, financial services and insurance; lifestyle; real estate and construction; media and entertainment; education; pharma; telecom; automobiles; hospitality, and government ministries. It generates business through direct clients, as well as through media agencies.

profile.company_profile: R K Swamy Limited is an India-based integrated marketing services company, offering a single-window solution for creative, media, data analytics and market research services. The Company's services include integrated marketing communications, customer data analytics and marketing technology, and full-service market research. Its integrated marketing communications include media planning and buying, digital, brand activation, brand consulting, branding & design, healthcare, content at scale, and advertising creative services. The Company's full-service market research services include quantitative studies, qualitative studies, CX measurement and syndicated studies. Its customer data analytics and marketing technology services include customer experience centers, campaign management, CX management and CRM. Its clients are primarily engaged in industries such as banking, financial services and insurance, automotive, fast-moving consumer goods, consumer durables, retail, and e-commerce.

Vertoz Ltd is an India-based company, which offers artificial intelligence (AI)-powered MadTech & CloudTech platforms. The Company provides digital advertising, marketing, media and monetization (MadTech) and digital identity, and cloud infrastructure (CloudTech) catering to businesses, digital marketers, advertising agencies, digital publishers, cloud providers, and technology companies. Its platforms offer omnichannel advertising, monetization and representation, performance advertising, ad exchange, digital media properties, domain name, cloud hosting and services, and others. The MadTech offerings include managed media buying, programmatic advertising, YouTube advertising, search advertising, social advertising, advertising exchange, performance marketing, media representation, influencer advertising, and more. The CloudTech offerings include cloud hosting, e-mail solutions, SSL certificates, domain names, corporate domain management, and others.

profile.company_profile: Cash UR Drive Marketing Limited is an out of home (OOH) advertising company. The Company’s core focus lies in facilitating advertisement and publicity services via transit media, outdoor media, campaign media, product promotion media and digital marketing services. It offers end-to-end services, which includes assisting clients in selecting suitable advertising channels within their budget and regional preferences, designing compelling advertisements and managing negotiations and bookings of ad-space with chosen media agencies and also acting as intermediaries connecting clients with relevant media outlets. Its streamlined process ensures timely publication or placement of advertisements, enabling its clients to reach their target audience. It offers a range of services in transit advertising solutions, such as cab branding, bus branding including e-bus branding, auto hood branding, and fleet branding. The Company also offers various digital marketing services.

Pramara Promotions Ltd is an India-based company, which is an integrated manufacturer and solutions provider in the toys and promotional products industry. The Company operates as a promotional marketing agency. It specializes in ideation, product development, and large-scale manufacturing for multinational corporations across fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), quick service restaurant, pharma, personal care, telecom, and retail. The Company’s offerings include toy manufacturing, original equipment manufacturer, consumer promotions, loyalty and rewards, cross promotions, point of sale marketing, trade, promotions, sweepstakes, corporate gifting and sourcing. Consumer promotion is equipped with multiple manufacturing capabilities and a global sourcing network, which designs a variety of promotional merchandise that suits the campaign theme, brand personality and typical customer profile. The Company’s Pramara factory is located in Daman on the western coast of India.

The Company’s businesses include Fever Audio Tool, Desi Martini, and Photo Library. Fever Audio Tool business carries out aggregation and creation of audio and multi-screen videos, audio feed which plays music inside across various stores, and distribution of in-house creative and niche celeb-based content to mobile and digital users. Desi Martini business carries out Internet related business by providing movie reviews and ratings under the name of www. desimartini.com. Photo Library business maintains a repository of copyrighted images. The business operations of its subsidiary HT Digital Streams Limited are dissemination of news, knowledge, information, entertainment, and content of general interest in English, Hindi, or any other language, globally through various digital and electronic media, and management of advertising time.

profile.company_profile: Crayons Advertising Limited is an India-based advertising solution company. The Company is engaged in providing an ecosystem and an end-to-end ad-tech communication solution platform for advertising media services. It operates a single business segment, namely advertising and marketing Services. The Company provides a range of services, including print media, electronic media, outdoor media services which cover advertising modes, such as newspapers, brochures, magazines, television channels, frequency modulation (FM) channels and display of outdoor hoardings. It also offers advisory services for clients to understand the course of action to be executed by them to brand their products and/or services. The Company also provides offline and online media services. It uses various Digital Media Tools, such as Marin Software, AdParlor, AdEspresso, Criteo, Adobe marketing cloud, App Nexus/Xandr, ReTargeter, Nielsen, and Moat.

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited is an India-based company engaged in the design, development, manufacture, repair, overhaul, upgrade, and servicing of a wide range of products, including aircraft, helicopters, aero-engines, avionics, accessories, and aerospace structures. The Company’s aircraft products include the HAWK, Light Combat Aircraft (LCA), SU-30 MKI, Intermediate Jet Trainer (IJT), Dornier, and HTT-40. Its helicopter products include the Dhruv, Cheetah, Chetak, Lancer, Cheetal, Rudra, Light Combat Helicopter (LCH), and Light Utility Helicopter (LUH). Its civil aviation products include Do-228 Aircraft (Civil) and DHRUV (ALH) - NG. Its space products include Structures, Propellant Tank, and Cryogenic Engines. Its system products include Flight Data Recorder, Panel Instruments, Ground Radars, Forgings, Castings, and Others. Its maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) products include Aircraft MRO, Helicopter MRO, Power Plant Services, and Systems, Accessories and Avionics.

Bharat Electronics Limited is an India-based company, which manufactures and supplies electronic equipment and systems for the defense sector as well as for non-defense markets. It manufactures electronic products and systems for the army, navy, and the air force. Its defense products include radar and fire control systems, weapon systems, communication, network centric systems (c4i), electronic warfare systems, avionics, anti-submarine warfare systems & sonars, electro-optics, tank electronics, gun upgrades, strategic components, and others. Its non-defense products include electronic voting machines, software solutions / services, healthcare solutions, civil aviation and solar cells/power plants, railway / metro / airport solutions, space electronics and systems, alternate energy solutions, secure communication solutions. It also offers software, electronic manufacturing services and cybersecurity. Its subsidiaries include BEL Optronic Devices Ltd. and BEL-THALES Systems Ltd.

Bharat Dynamics Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in the manufacturing of guided missile systems and allied equipment for the Indian Armed Forces. The Company is working in collaboration with the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) and foreign original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) for manufacture and supply of various missiles and allied equipment to the Indian Armed Forces. It has a product portfolio consisting of surface to air missiles (SAMs), air-to-air missiles, anti-tank guided missiles (ATGMs), underwater weapons, launchers, countermeasures and test equipment. Its products include Akash SAM, Astra Weapon System, Milan 2T ATGM, Konkurs - M ATGM, submarine fired decoy and heavy weight torpedo. The Company also offers product life cycle support and refurbishment/life extension of vintage missiles. The Company also commenced the export of selected defense equipment and has entered into strategic alliances with public and private sector companies.

Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd. is an India-based warship building company. The Company is under the administrative control of the Ministry of Defense, primarily catering to the shipbuilding requirements of the Indian Navy and the Indian Coast Guard. The Company's divisions include ship division, engineering division and engine division. It has built over 800 platforms, including 114 warships for Indian Navy, Indian Coast Guard and Govt. of Mauritius and Govt. of Seychelles. It has designed and built warships, such as frigates, anti-submarine warfare corvettes, fleet tanker and landing ship tank (large), among others. Its engineering product includes prefabricated steel bridges of various ranges and types, and various deck machinery items such as anchor capstans, boat davits, and others. The Company is also engaged in engineering activities. It is involved in assembly/testing/overhauling of marine diesel engines and the manufacture of naval surface guns.

Data Patterns (India) Limited is an India-based company. It is a vertically integrated defense and aerospace electronics solutions provider catering to the indigenously developed defense products industry. The Company operates in a single business segment, namely manufacture, sale and service of defense electronics. It offers Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) boards, ATE and test systems, RF and microwave products, electronic warfare products, rugged displays, radar and radar subsystems, identify friend and Foe products, avionic systems, laser and electro optic systems, space systems, power supply products, naval systems, communication products, and fire control systems, high-speed processors, consoles, and navigation systems, and others. It designs COTS module products that are used in rugged applications and automatic test equipment platforms. It also provides hardware design, product development, FPGA, software, microwave, mechanical product design, manufacturing and other services.

Astra Microwave Products Limited is engaged in the business of designing, developing, and manufacturing and supplying value-added radio frequency and microwave super components, sub-systems and systems. Its products include AESA AAAU: AAAU for Uttam Radar, PPTR: Pulsed Phased Array Tracking Radar, PATM-II: Phased Array Auto Track telemetry (PATM) Antenna System, Drishti d4 Radar, DWR: X, C-Band Doppler Weather Radar Systems, and SRES: Radiation Mode Test & Evaluation facility for Radar EW Systems. The Company provides cutting-edge technological solutions for defense, space, meteorology, homeland security, systems integration, antenna technology, global navigation satellite systems, and unmanned ground vehicles. Its outdoor antenna test range offers a realistic testing environment for antennas. Its subsidiaries include Bhavyabhanu Electronics Private Limited, Aelius Semiconductors Pte. Ltd., Astra Foundation, and Astra Space Technologies Private Limited.

Zen Technologies Limited is focused on providing defense training and anti-drone solutions and builds training systems for imparting defense training and measuring combat readiness of security forces. It designs, develops and manufactures training simulators, anti-drone systems and operations for para-military forces, armed forces, security forces, police and government departments. Its segment is Defence and Homeland. Its solutions include anti-drone systems, combat training center, live ranges, live simulation and virtual simulation. Its anti-drone system works on drone detection, classification and tracking on passive surveillance, camera sensors and neutralization of the threat through jamming the drone communications. Its live ranges include Air-To-Ground Firing Range Scoring System, Tank Zeroing System, Multi-Functional Target System, and others. The laser instrumented tactical engagement simulator, or Zen TacSim, offers realistic force-on-force mission rehearsal training.

Aequs Limited is an India-based company. The Company is a vertically integrated precision component manufacturer in the Aerospace Segment and Consumer Segment. Its product portfolio comprises components for engine systems, landing systems, cargo and interiors, structures, assemblies and turnings for its aerospace clients and consumer electronics, plastics and consumer durables for its consumer clients. Its segments include Aerospace and Consumer. Its Aerospace segment includes forging, precision machining, surface treatment, aerostructure assemblies, metal press forming, and heat treatment. Its Consumer segment includes machining, molding, tooling, assemblies, painting and printing, tool room, metal press forming, advance surface engineering including secondary processes, thermoplastic molding and nonstick coatings. Its consumer electronics include components for portable computers and smart devices.

Apollo Micro Systems Limited is an electronic, electromechanical, and engineering design, manufacturing, and supplies company. It specializes in the design, development, and sale of high-performance solutions that are critical for missions and time-sensitive operations. Its portfolio comprises products catering to the needs of a wide range of customers across various industries. It offers a wide range of products and services, including electronic manufacturing, PCB fabrication, embedded software and hardware design, printed circuit board assembly, concept-to-product development, host interface development, and custom-built electronic systems. Its product-based solutions include avionics systems, aerospace, ground defense, space, transportation, embedded solutions, and homeland security. Its service-based solutions include electronic manufacturing services, electronic-CAD design, mechanical engineering services, information technology and software services, and hardware designing.

profile.company_profile: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited, formerly Megasoft Limited, is an India-based manufacturer and service provider of defense systems and security solutions. The Company specializes in the design, development, and production of defense and aerospace solutions. Its portfolio includes Avionics, Naval Systems, Torpedo Systems, Communication Systems, Submarine Platform, Radars and Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems tailored to meet the needs of modern armed forces and homeland security. It supports its clients with end-to-end solutions, from initial concept design through to full-scale production, testing, and deployment. Its services consist of system solutions and engineering; hardware design and development; software design and development, and production. Its product lineup spans hard-kill and soft-kill countermeasures, such as spoofers, interceptors, jammers, and full-spectrum counter-unmanned aerial systems (C-UAS) platforms, engineered to dominate drone threats across land, sea, and sky.

Hindalco Industries Limited is an India-based metals flagship company. The Company is primarily engaged in the business of manufacturing and distribution of aluminium, copper, and its products across the globe. It operates through four segments: Novelis, Aluminium Upstream, Aluminium Downstream and Copper. The Novelis segment is engaged in producing and selling aluminium sheet and light gauge products and operating in four continents: North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Aluminium Upstream segment is engaged in bauxite and coal mining, alumina specials, refineries, metal, and power. The Aluminium Downstream segment includes aluminium value-added products, such as flat rolled products, extrusion, and foils. The Copper segment includes copper cathode, copper rods, precious metals, and di-ammonium phosphate. Its brands include Hindalco PrizTec, Hindalco Ecoedge C, Hindalco Ecoedge G, Hindalco Everlast, Eternia, Freshwrapp, FUSALOX and Totalis.

National Aluminium Company Limited is an India-based integrated bauxite-alumina-aluminum- power complex. The Company's operations include bauxite mines, alumina refinery, aluminum smelter, captive power plant, rolled products unit, port facilities, wind power plants, solar power and Nalco Research & Technology Centre - testing services. Its segments include chemicals and Aluminium. Chemicals segment includes calcined alumina, alumina hydrate and other related products. Aluminium segment includes aluminum ingots, wire rods, billets, strips, rolled and other related products. It is operating approximately 22.75 lakh MT per annum alumina refinery plant located at Damanjodi in Koraput district of Odisha and 4.60 lakh MT per annum aluminum smelter located at Angul, Odisha. It is operating four wind power plants with total capacity of 198.40 megawatts. The Company, through its joint venture company, Khanij Bidesh India Limited, is focused on sourcing battery minerals like lithium and cobalt.

Arfin India Limited is an India-based company engaged primarily in the business of manufacturing, trading, and selling various non-ferrous metal products. The Company's main product line includes aluminum wire rods, aluminum deox, cored wires, aluminum alloy ingots, ferro alloys, inoculant, and conductor and cables. Its aluminum deox product includes aluminum notch bars, aluminum cubes, and aluminum shots. Its aluminum drawn wire product includes bare wire and annealed wire. Its aluminum wire rods product includes aluminum wire rod 9.5 millimeters (mm), aluminum wire rod 7.5 mm and an aluminum alloy wire rod. Its inoculant products include barium (Ba), calcium (Ca), cerium (Ce), and others. Its cored wire mill products include calcium silicon cored wire, cafe cored wire, ferro silicon cored wire, and others. It covers supply to the steel sector, automobile sector, and power sector. Its manufacturing facilities are located at Chhatral, Dhanot and Vadaswami in the state of Gujarat.

MMP Industries Limited is an India-based company. The Company is primarily engaged in the business of manufacturing, selling, distribution and trading of aluminum powder, aluminum pyro and flake powder, aluminum paste, aluminum conductor and aluminum foils. The Company is also engaged in the trading and manufacturing of manganese monoxide (MnO) and manganese dioxide (MnO2) Powder. The Company operates through four segments: Aluminium Powder, Aluminium Pastes and Atomized Powder; Aluminium Foil; Aluminium Conductor, and Others. It offers a variety of harnesses for different vehicles including passenger and commercial vehicles, two and three-wheelers, farm equipment and off-road vehicles. Its services encompass three-dimensional (3D) computer-aided design, printed circuit board design and routing, 3D printing, prototyping, virtual and physical validation and technology implementation support. The Company operates 26 facilities consisting of manufacturing and assembly sites and technical centers across India.

profile.company_profile: United Spirits Limited is an India-based company. The Company is s engaged in the business of manufacture, purchase and sale of beverage alcohol and other allied spirits, including through tie-up manufacturing units and through strategic franchising of some of its brands. The Company operates through two segments: Beverage alcohol, and Sports. Beverage alcohol segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase, franchise and sale of beverage alcohol and other allied spirits. Sports segment owns rights to operate sports franchises. The Company’s portfolio includes premium brands such as Johnnie Walker, Black Dog, Black & White, Vat 69, Antiquity, Signature, Singelton, Royal Challenge, McDowell’s No 1, Smirnoff, Ketel One, Tanqueray, Captain Morgan, and others. The Company’s subsidiary is Royal Challengers Sports Private Limited. Royal Challengers Sports Private Limited, holds the rights to operate a sports franchise.

Radico Khaitan Limited is an India-based manufacturer of alcohol and alcoholic products. The Company is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of alcoholic products, such as Indian-made foreign liquor (IMFL) and country liquor. The Company operates through Alcohol and Alcoholic Beverages segment. It offers various brands, such as rampur indian single malt whisky, jaisalmer indian craft gin, royal ranthambore heritage collection royal crafted whisky, happiness in a bottle, magic moments dazzle vodka, magic moments verve, magic moments vodka, magic moments vodka cocktails, after dark premium whisky, morpheus blue xo brandy, morpheus xo brandy, 8pm premium black whisky, 8pm whisky, 1965 the spirit of victory premium xxx rum, whytehall premium brandy, old admiral brandy, and contessa rum. It has two distillery campuses located in India. The Company has a total capacity of over 321 million liters and operates 44 bottling units, spread across the country.

United Breweries Limited is an India-based beer company, which is engaged in the manufacturing, purchasing and selling of beer and non-alcoholic beverages. The Company’s Beer segment includes the manufacture, purchase and sale of beer, including licensing of brands. Its product range includes internationally recognized beers, non-alcoholic beverages, packaged drinking water, and soda. Its alcoholic brands include Heineken Original; Heineken Silver; Amstel Bier; Amstel Grande Bier; Kingfisher Premium; Kingfisher Strong; Kingfisher Ultra; Kingfisher Ultra Max; Kingfisher Ultra Witbier; Kingfisher Storm; Kingfisher Blue; Kingfisher Flavour Mango; Kingfisher Flavour Lemon; Bullet Super Strong; Cannon 1000, and others. Its non-alcoholic brands include Heineken 0.0; Kingfisher Premium Packaged Drinking Water; Kingfisher Strong Power Soda, and Kingfisher Ultra Premium Soda. The Company has manufacturing facilities in India. It has operations in approximately 50 international markets.

Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited is an India-based spirits company. The Company is engaged in the business of manufacturing and marketing of Indian-Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) products. Its product categories include whisky, gin, brandy, rum, vodka and packaged drinking water. The Company's whisky products include Arthaus Collective Blended Malt Scotch Whisky, Sterling Reserve Blend 7 Whisky, Officer’s Choice Whisky, ICONiQ Winter Whisky, X&O Barrel, Srishti Premium Whisky, and Sterling Reserve Blend 10 Whisky. Its gin products include Zoya Special Batch Gin, Zoya Watermelon Gin and Zoya Espresso Coffee Gin. Its brandy products include Kyron Premium Brandy and Officer’s Choice Brandy. Its rum products include Jolly Roger Rum and Officer’s Choice Rum. Its Class 21 vodka is available in 750 ml, 375 ml, 180 ml and 90 ml. The Company is the legal and beneficial owner of worldwide right, title interest in the brands Mansion House and Savoy Club (excluding certain territories).

Tilaknagar Industries Ltd. is an alcoholic beverage company. The Company is primarily involved in the manufacturing and sale of Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) and its related products. The Company has a diverse portfolio of brands in various liquor categories, including brandy, whisky, flandy, gin, and rum. Its brand portfolio includes Mansion House Brandy, Imperial Blue, Courrier Napoleon Brandy-Green, Mansion House Gold Whiskey, Madira Gold Dark XXX Rum, and Blue Lagoon Gin, Blue Lagoon Gin Orange, Blue Lagoon Gin Lemon, Mansion House Cherry Flandy, Mansion House Orange Flandy, Mansion House Peach Flandy, Mansion House Green Apple Flandy, Courrier Napoleon Finest Pure Grape French Brandy, Imperial Red, Imperial Black, and Mansion House Chambers Brandy. It is also focused on the luxury segment with Monarch Legacy Edition Brandy and Seven Islands Pure Malt Whisky. The Company exports its products to East and South-East Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and Europe.

India Glycols Limited is an India-based green chemical company. The Company manufactures bio-based specialties and performance chemicals, such as green technology-based bulk, natural gums and industrial gases, potable spirits and Ennature biopharma. The Company’s segments include Bio-Based Specialties and Performance Chemicals, Potable Spirits, and Ennature Biopharma. Bio-Based Specialties and Performance Chemicals include bio-based glycols, glycol ethers, glycol ether esters, bio-based ethylene oxide, and power alcohol (Biofuel). Potable Spirits include Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL), branded Country liquor and extra neutral alcohol (ENA). It serves various industries, including personal care, pharma and healthcare, textile, automotive, oil and gas, paint and coatings, food ingredients, industrial and manufacturing, and packaging. Its personal care includes biopolymer for cosmetics, extra neutral alcohol, liquid nitrogen, sterigas, and bio carbon dioxide.

profile.company_profile: Piccadily Agro Industries Limited is an India-based company. It manufactures White Crystal Sugar from Sugar cane cultivated in the surrounding rural areas and Rectified Spirit, Carbon dioxide Gas, Extra Neutral Alcohol (ENA) from Molasses/ Rice / Wheat, Malt, Pet. Its segments include Sugar and Distillery. The Sugar segment includes products, such as sugar, molasses, power, and bagasse. The Distillery segment includes products, such as liquor, malt, carbon dioxide gas and ethanol. The Sugar Mill has produced approximately 66,7800 quintals of Sugar and produced approximately 54,8730 quintals of molasses. The Distillery segment has produced approximately 61,79,868 cases of Malta, approximately 8,136 cases of Marshal Rum under the Country liquor category. It has also produced approximately 8,136 cases of Golden Wings whisky, approximately 49,371 cases of Whistler Whisky, over 3,912 cases of Kamet (Single Malt Whisky), approximately 105,992 cases of Indri No. 1 (Single Malt Whisky).

Globus Spirits Limited is an India-based company, which is primarily engaged in the business of the manufacture and sale of Indian Made Indian Liquor (IMIL), Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL), and Bulk Alcohol. Its business segments include manufacturing and consumer business. The Company’s consumer products are categorized under Regular & Others and Prestige & Above categories, which include Ghoomar, Heer Ranjha, Shahi, Globus Special Series, Goldee - Blue and Red, Globus Spirits Dry Gin, Oakton Barrel Aged Grain Whisky, and White Lace. The Company’s manufacturing products include extra neutral alcohol (ENA), bioethanol, special denatured spirit, technical alcohol, franchisee bottling, byproducts, and fusel oil. Its manufacturing facilities spread across West Bengal, Bihar, Haryana, Panagarh, Jharkhand, and Rajasthan. Its fully integrated plants facilitate the production of Rectified Spirit, Ethanol, Grain Neutral Alcohol, Value-priced Spirits, and Premium Spirits.

G M Breweries Limited is an India-based alcoholic beverage company engaged in the manufacture of alcoholic liquor. The Company is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of country liquor (CL) and Indian-made Foreign Liquor (IMFL). The Company's brands include G.M.SANTRA, G.M.DOCTOR, G.M.LIMBU PUNCH, and G.M.DILBAHAR SOUNF. It has a bottling plant in Virar, Maharashtra with a capacity of producing approximately 50,000 cases per day. The Company has the facility to blend and bottle both Indian-made foreign liquor and country liquor.

Associated Alcohols & Breweries Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in the manufacturing of liquor. The Company is primarily engaged in the business of manufacturing and selling extra neutral alcohol (ENA), Indian Made Indian Liquor (IMIL) (Country Liquor), Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) and Ethanol. Its segments include Potable Alcohols Division and Ethanol Division. The Potable Alcohols segment is involved in the production and sale of IMFL, IMIL, and ENA. Further, this segment also provides manufacturing services related to these products. This segment caters to various consumer preferences and ensures a comprehensive presence in the alcoholic beverage market. The Ethanol segment is involved in the production and distribution of grain-based ethanol, primarily supplying it to oil marketing companies in India for blending with petrol. Its brands include Titanium Vodka, Lemount Brandy, Central Province Rum, Central Province Vodka, Bombay Special Whisky, and others.

Firstsource Solutions Limited is an India-based company. The Company is engaged in providing information technology (IT) enabled business process management (BPM) services to banking and financial services, healthcare, communication media and technology and other diverse industries. The Company operates through four segments: Banking and Financial Services (BFS), Healthcare, Communication, Media, and Technology (CMT), and Diverse Industries. The BFS segment’s technology-driven solutions enable BFS and born-digital businesses to personalize customer experiences. Its platform-based services, digital patient access and Intelligent Automation offerings drive superior patient engagement, financial experience, and improved financial performance for hospitals. The CMT segment’s customer experience management and digitally enabled contact center solutions help CMT businesses. The Company also focuses on customer experience outsourcing for retail and ecommerce businesses.

eClerx Services Limited is an India-based industry-focused specialist services firm managing and improving complex data-driven processes. The Company provides business process management, automation and analytics services to various sectors, including financial services, communications, retail, fashion, media & entertainment, manufacturing, travel & leisure and technology companies. The Company's divisions include eClerx Customer Operations, eClerx Digital and eClerx Markets. eClerx Customer Operations include operations support, technology solutions, data analytics & reporting, customer experience and consulting services. eClerx Digital includes data management, analytics & insights, digital marketing operations, and creative services. eClerx Markets derivative trade support, cash securities operations, regulatory compliance & data, document management, analytics, and technology products. Its products include Compliance Manager, Market360, Fluiid4, DocIntel and Merchandiser+.

One Point One Solutions Ltd. is a customized business process management (BPM) services provider. Alldigi Tech Limited is an outsourcing solutions company. Its CXM services include customer service, collections, healthcare solutions, finance and accounting outsourcing, background verification, insurance services, and know your customer/anti-money laundering services. It offers a single, integrated, fully automated platform to handle functions from payroll input collection to payroll related compliance. Its EXM services include SmartPay and SmartHR. Its SmartHR creates a workplace with an end-to-end HR solution. Its SmartPay provides an automated platform to handle functions from payroll input collection to payroll related compliance. It serves various industries, including manufacturing, retail and e-commerce, healthcare and pharma, fast moving consumer goods, and infrastructure and construction.

Kandarp Digi Smart Bpo Limited is an India-based company, which offers business process services. Its voice-based support services include tele verification, service calls, collections and recoveries, retention, online support, C-SAT and AMC services. The Company's field support services include contact point verifications, payment and docs pickup, FRCU activities, vendor verification, document check, complaint redressal, mystery audits and declared audits. Its back-office processing includes data entry, form processing and skip tracing (for all products and buckets).

Cadsys (India) Limited is an India-based domain-focused geospatial information systems (GIS) and engineering business technology service provider. The Company is primarily engaged in providing full life-cycle engineering solutions as well as information technology and field engineering services in the domains such as telecom, community antenna television (CATV), oil and gas, electricity, and other utilities. Its Concord-Pro product provides intelligent solutions. Its Concord-Pro product has an ability to configure as per user requirements and find usage in diverse avenues. These are inclusive of graphic re-alignment of land base and facilities, data cleanup of GIS records, data migration and performance management, among others. Its services include GIS and mapping services, telecom and CATV services, and engineering and project management services. Its telco engineering services capabilities include field survey and consultation, fiber management, and network design and documentation.

We Win Limited is a customer relationship management services company. It operates in the business of the call center services segment. Its services include government technology services that include grievance & management system tailored to governance needs and streamlines the grievance redressal and feedback collection process, among others; Digital customer experience (CX), which provides artificial intelligence (AI) powered services, which include new client acquisition, outbound sales, e-mail support, social media management, among others; Human resource(HR) analytics involves collecting and analyzing HR data to understand its implications for business goals, and to make informed decisions, its services include reporting, descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive; and Global Capability Center (GCC), which offers a complete suite of services designed to help companies to establish and scale GCCs. It also offers AI-talent matching, tailored talent pools and end to end recruitment.

HRH Next Services Ltd is an India-based company, which is engaged in providing business process outsourcing (BPO) service. The Company is specialized in engaging conversations across multiple platforms to help businesses thrive. The Company offer a wide range of services, including customer service, sales, and marketing. The Company offers services inbound call center service, omnichannel, outbound call center service, digital BPO, voice bots, predictive analytics, chatbots, speech analytics, premium vernacular services, advisory and consulting services, contact center services, and digital services. The Company as an inbound call center service provider, helps customers with their inquiries, resolving problems, and maintaining customer satisfaction. Its omnichannel provides a diverse range of services including live chat, email, social media, and phone support, tailored to deliver a seamless and personalized encounter.

Polycab India Limited is a manufacturer of wires and cables. It is engaged in fast-moving electrical goods (FMEG). Its segment includes Wires and cables, FMEG, and Other. Wire and cable segment is engaged in the manufacturing and selling of wires and cables. FMEG segment is engaged in fans, light-emitting diode (LED) lighting and luminaires, switches, switchgear, solar products, pumps, conduits, and domestic appliances. Other segment consists of the engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) business, which includes design, engineering, supply of materials, survey, execution and commissioning of power distribution, and rural electrification projects on a trunky basis. It is also in the business of engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) projects. It owns over 28 manufacturing facilities, located across the states of Gujarat, Maharashtra, Uttarakhand, and the union territory of Daman. Its products include Flexible Wires, Building Wires LV and MV Power Cables, and others.

KEI Industries Limited is a manufacturer of wires and cables. The Company's segments include Cables and Wires, Stainless Steel Wire, and Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) Projects. Cables and Wires segment is engaged in the manufacturing, sale and marketing of all ranges of power cables, such as low tension (LT), high tension (HT) and extra-high voltage (EHV), control and instrumentation cables, specialty cables, elastomeric/rubber cables, flexible and house wires, and winding wires. Stainless Steel Wire segment comprises manufacturing, sale and job work related to stainless steel wire. EPC Projects segment comprises the design, engineering, supply, erection, testing and commissioning of high-voltage and extra-high-voltage underground cabling projects from 33 kilovolts (kV) to 400 kV, substations (AIS & GIS) on a turnkey basis up to 400 KV and conversion of overhead line to underground line for complete town including HT and LT distribution system, among others.

R R Kabel Limited is an India-based consumer electrical company, which is engaged in manufacturing and selling wires and cables, including house wires, industrial wires, power cables and special cables, and fast-moving electric goods (FMEG), including fans, lighting, switches, and appliances. The Company’s segments include Wire and Cable and FMEG. Its Wire and Cable segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of wires and cables. Its FMEG segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of fans, light-emitting diode (LED) lighting, switches, switchgear, water heaters, and domestic appliances. It manufactures, markets, and sells fans and lights under the brand RR Signature Fans and Lights. It offers premium electrical products under the RR Signature appliances brand, which include water heater, immersion heater, iron, and air cooler. Its brand, Arraystorm, focuses on the LED lighting business. It owns and operates approximately five integrated manufacturing facilities across India.

Finolex Cables Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in the manufacturing of electrical cables, communication cables, and other electrical appliances. The Company’s segments include Electrical cables, Communication cables, Copper rods, and Others. The Electrical cables segment manufactures light-duty electrical cables and power and control cables. The Communication cables segment includes copper-based cables and optical fiber (glass-based) cables (OFC). The Copper rods segment is engaged in manufacturing continuous cast copper rods (CCC rods), which are used in the production of copper-based electrical and communication cables. Its product portfolio includes wires and cables, fans, water heaters, switches, switchgear, home appliances-room heaters, home appliances-iron, lights, conduits and fittings, and smart homes. Its wires and cables include house wires, agriculture cables, ofc, telephone cables, LAN cables, speaker cables, and power cables.

KSH International Limited is an India-based manufacturer of magnet winding wires. It is also engaged in the exporting of magnet winding wires. The Company’s key products include round- enameled copper/ aluminum magnet winding wires, paper-insulated rectangular copper/ aluminum magnet winding wires, continuously transposed conductors, rectangular enameled copper/ aluminum magnet winding wires and bunched paper-insulated copper magnet winding wires. Its products are vital for transformers, motors, and other electrical equipment that ensure a reliable power supply in industrial settings. These products (transformers, motors, alternators and generators) find application in end-use industries such as power (generation, transmission and distribution), renewables, industrials, railways, automotives (electric vehicle and internal combustion engine), home appliances, refrigeration and air conditioning. The Company markets and sells its products through its brand KSH.

Universal Cables Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in manufacturing and sale of electrical and other cables, capacitors, wires and conductors, and turnkey projects predominantly relating to electrical cables/capacitors. The Company's product categories include cables, capacitors, and handling and installation. It offers XLPE cables, such as extra high voltage cables, medium voltage cable, low voltage cables, and aerial bunched cables. Its polyvinyl chloride (PVC) cables offer power and control cable, winding wire and flat motor leads. It also offers elastomeric cables. Its capacitors include high voltage capacitors, low voltage capacitors, harmonic filters (HV & LV), surge protection / special duty capacitors, and automatic power factor correction (APFC) panels. Its cable monitoring system (CMS) uses a distributed temperature sensor (DTS) system and offers a complete package including installation and commissioning, training, and maintenance.

V-Marc India Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in manufacturing polyvinyl chloride (PVC) insulated wires and cables. The Company manufactures wires and cables, including single and multicore with copper/aluminum conductors, XLPE/PVC insulation, flat, coaxial, LAN, LT power/control, medium voltage, HT, and specialty cables. Its products include Miniature Circuit Breakers products, e- beam, communication cables, HT Cables, LT cables, Light Duty Cables, and Geyser. Its e-beam wires range includes Flexi-TUF eB-HFFR Wires, eB+ Power Cables, and Solar DC Cable. The Company manufactures various types of wires and cables in Single and Multi-core with Copper/Aluminum Conductors, having XLPE/PVC insulation, Flat Cables, Co-axial Cables, LAN Cables, LT Power/Control Cable, Medium Voltage Covered Conductors, HT Cables and Specialty Cables. Its range of wires and cables possess properties of FR, HRFR, FRLS, HFFR, and others, which cater to specific needs of clients.

profile.company_profile: Antelopus Selan Energy Limited, formerly Selan Exploration Technology Limited, is an India-based company, which is engaged in the business of oil and gas exploration and production. The Company holds a portfolio of oil and gas fields: Bakrol, Lohar and Karjisan, which are located in Gujarat. It also operates four contract areas: two offshore (one each on the West Coast and East Coast of India) and two onshore (one each in Assam and Andhra Pradesh). The Bakrol field is a productive oil field located in the Cambay Basin, around 16 kilometers (kms) south-east of Ahmedabad city, which covers an area of 36 square kilometers (sq. kms). The Bakrol field's reservoir zones are K-VIII and K-IX of the Kalol formation from the Middle Eocene age. The Lohar field is located approximately 35 kms west-north-west of Ahmedabad city, which covers an area of five sq. kms. The Karjisan field covers an area of around five sq. kms, which is located in Ahmedabad-Mehsana tectonic block of the Cambay Basin.

Its segments include Hi-tech Agri Input Products division, which include micro and sprinkler irrigation, solar Agri pump, integrated irrigation projects and tissue culture plants; Plastic division, which includes PVC piping products, polyethylene piping products, piping projects and plastic sheets; Agro Processing division, which includes fruits, onion products and biogas, and Other business division, which includes equipment manufacturing, solar thermal products, solar photovoltaic grid and off grid products and also includes solar power generation investments.

Apollo Pipes Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pipes and fittings. The Company's product portfolio includes a range of over 2500 stock keeping units (SKUs), including chlorinated polyvinyl chloride (cPVC), unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (uPVC) and high-density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes, water storage tanks, PVC taps, fittings and solvents. Its borewell system products include column pipes and casing pipes. Its bath fitting products include faucets, showers, health faucets, cisterns and accessories. Its agricultural products include agricultural pipes and fittings, HDPE pipes and coils and sprinkler system. The Company caters to various industries, such as agriculture, construction, infrastructure and telecom ducting segments. Its sewerage solution product include SWR-drainage system and underground drainage system. It also offers uPVC and cPVC plumbing system, and kitchen tank.

Jai Corp Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in manufacturing businesses, such as steel, plastic processing and spinning yarn. The Company is primarily involved in manufacturing activities, which produces woven sacks/fabric, jumbo bags, high-density polyethylene (HDPE) twine, polypropylene (PP) staple fiber and geotextiles, spun yarn and production, processing and trading of galvanized steel product. Its segments include Steel, Plastic Processing, Spinning, Asset Management Activity, Real Estate. Steel segment comprises the production, processing and trading of galvanized steel products. Plastic Processing segment comprises production of woven sacks/fabric, jumbo bags, high density polyethylene (HDPE) twine, PP staple fiber, geotextiles. Spinning segment comprises the sale of spun yarn. Asset Management Activity segment comprises investment advisory services. Real Estate Segment comprises development of land and buildings.

Knowledge Realty Trust is a real estate investment trust (REIT). The Company owns and manages an office portfolio in India. Its portfolio comprises six city-center offices and 24 business parks/centers, with some of its assets being developments in their respective sub-markets. Its portfolio assets house a diversified tenant mix of prominent multinational tenants, including Fortune 500 companies and Global Capability Centers (GCCs), as well as domestic corporates. Its portfolio assets are spread across six cities, namely Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram and Gift City, Ahmedabad. profile.company_profile: Apcotex Industries Limited is an India-based specialty chemical company. The Company produces synthetic lattices (VP Latex, SBR and Acrylic Latex, Nitrile Latex) and synthetic rubber (high styrene rubber, nitrile butadiene rubber). It has a range of products based on Styrene-Butadiene Chemistry and Acryonitrile-Butadiene Chemistry available in the market. The Company’s range of Latexes are used for paper / paperboard coating, carpet backing, tire cord dipping, construction, gloves-examination, surgical and industrial use. The various grades of synthetic rubber find application in products, such as footwear, automotive components, v-belts, conveyor belts and hoses. It exports to over 45 countries, including the Indian Subcontinent, Southeast Asia, the Middle East. Its products include Apcoflex N745, Apcoflex N746, Apcoflex N747, Apcoflex N749, Apcoflex NVC70E, Apcoflex NVC70E-P, APCOTEX TSN 100, APCOTEX PC 400, APCOTEX TSN 400, APCOTEX PT 600, APCOTEX PT 663, APCOTEX PT 800 and other.

profile.company_profile: PIX Transmissions Limited is an India-based manufacturer of belts and related mechanical power transmission products in India. The Company has manufacturing units, as well as an automated rubber mixing facility located in Nagpur, India. Its facilities include a design center, fabrication workshop and elaborate testing facilities. The Company also has an automated mixing plant, as well as an ultra-modern production facility. The Company has overseas subsidiary operations in Europe, and the Middle East, in addition to over 250 committed channel partners in over 100 countries worldwide. The Company’s products include V-Belts, Ribbed / Poly-V Belts, Timing / Synchronous, Banded Belts, Special Belts, Automotive Belts, Industrial Belts, Agriculture Belts, Lawn & Garden Belts, Powerware Products, and Accessories. Its belts are used in mining and construction, power generation units, steel, cement, ceramic, textile, flour mills, oil and petroleum, machine tools and an array of applications.

Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited is an India-based end-of-life tire (ELT) material recycler. The Company is primarily engaged in the recycling of waste tires/ELT and the manufacturing of value-added products. The Company is engaged in manufacturing crumb rubber, crumb rubber modifier (CRM), crumb rubber modified bitumen (CRMB), polymer modified bitumen (PMB), bitumen emulsion, reclaimed rubber/ultrafine crumb rubber compound, high carbon steel shot, high carbon steel grit, high carbon cut wire shot (polished), and high carbon cut wire shot (conditioned), among others. Its products are used in road construction and repair, tire manufacturing, and the automotive parts industry. The Company’s manufacturing units are located in Panipat (Haryana), Wada (Maharashtra), Haldia (West Bengal), Gummidipundi (Tamil Nadu), and Kala Amb (Himachal Pradesh). Its subsidiaries include Global Recycle LLC and Tinna Rubber B.V.

GRP Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in the business of manufacturing of reclaimed rubber, custom die forms, engineering plastics and polymer composites. The Company’s other businesses include power generation from windmills, manufacturing of engineering plastics, custom die forms and polymer composite products. It has manufacturing plants in India and sales in domestic as well as international markets. It operates five business verticals (reclaim rubber, engineering plastics, repurposed polyolefins, polymer composite and custom die forms) with seven manufacturing units across India with an installed capacity to handle 81,200 metric tons per annum to service the needs of the global polymer industry. It produces reclaimed rubber from end-of-life tires, tread peelings, natural rubber and butyl tubes, and molded rubber products for use in both tire and non-tire rubber products. Its subsidiaries include GRP Circular Solutions Ltd and GRP Circular Solutions Ltd.

Harrisons Malayalam Ltd is an India-based company. The Company is engaged in tea and rubber cultivation along with minor crops such as pineapple, cardamom, pepper, and other spices. It has three reportable segments, namely Tea, Rubber, and Others. Its products and services include Tea, Rubber, Harrisons Tea Extracts, Tea Town, Harrisons Heritage, Exports, and Consumer Products. The Company cultivates approximately 14,000 hectares (ha). Its primary products are rubber, tea, and pineapple, which cultivates on approximately 7,400 ha, 6,000 ha and 1000 ha, respectively. It produces approximately 9,000 tons of Rubber, 20,000 tons of tea and 25,000 tons of Pineapple. The Company has eleven tea estates located in Kerala and two in Tamil Nadu. It has eleven rubber estates which are located in Kerala. The Company’s subsidiary is Malayalam Plantations Limited.

Rubfila International Limited is a manufacturer of both talcum coated and silicon coated heat-resistant latex rubber threads in India. The Company’s segments include Latex Rubber Thread and Corrugated Carton Box. Its products include Talc Coated Rubber Thread; Silicon Coated Rubber Thread (SCR); Coloured Rubber Thread; Furniture Grade Rubber Thread; Rubber Threads for Medical Applications; Food Grade Rubber Threads; Rubber Thread for Catheter Making, and Rubber Theads in Bobbins. It produces Talc Coated Rubber threads under various colors: new super white (NSW), blue white, snow white, and black. Rubber threads are also used to make fishing lures and in pole fishing. It offers a range of colored rubber threads for niche’ applications like toys, fishing and others. With its two manufacturing facilities based in Kerala and Tamil Nadu, it has facilities in the world to manufacture Heat-Resistant Latex Rubber Threads, both Talc Coated Rubber Thread, and SCR.

Gayatri Rubbers and Chemicals Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of rubber products. Its solutions include architectural sector, automobile sector, sponge rubber components, PVC components, industrial sector, railway sector and defense sector. It manufactures architectural sector rubbers like Euro series, Domal series, Z sections, fireproof door rubber, fireproof window rubber and others. It develops and manufactures automobile extrusion and molding rubber items which are used in all electric vehicles, commercial vehicles like trucks, buses and earthmovers, and all four wheelers, three wheelers, and two wheelers. It offers nonconductive as well as conductive sponge rubber solutions for electrical meter industries, packing industries, engineering industries and all other required industries. It manufactures and supplies railway rubber pads and gaskets used in Indian railways and metros. Its brands include GOYAL and Elements India.

ELGI Rubber Co Ltd is engaged in providing solutions to the rubber industry. It is also engaged in the business of manufacturing reclaimed rubber, retreading machinery, and retreading rubber. It sells its products through various brands, including Jet, CRS, Armonas, Pincott, Carbrasive, Midwest Rubber, Westernweld, Rubber Resources and Kooltread. Its products include tire retreading and repair machinery, retreading and repair tools, curing system, repairs, retreading consumables, and reclaim rubber. Its tire retreading and repair machinery includes an inspection spreader, buffing machine, building machine, envelope spreader, electric autoclave, and others. Its retreading and repair tools include RASP blades, full circle RASP blades, and others. Its curing system includes ultra series inside envelope, ultra series outside envelope, max series outside envelope, flexseal, inside & outside envelope seal, and others. Its reclaim rubber products include Butyl, Chloro Butyl, and WTR.

Sampann Utpadan India Limited is an India-based company engaged in producing, manufacturing, supplying, distributing, transforming, converting, transmitting, processing, developing, storing, and procuring all forms of non-conventional and renewable power and energy and any such products and by-products derived from such business. It is also engaged in the business of manufacturing of reclaimed rubber. Its segments include Non-Conventional Energy and Reclaimed Rubber. The Non-Conventional Energy segment generates electricity by wind energy and transfers the same to power grids. The Reclaimed Rubber segment is a global supplier of crumb rubber, whole tire reclaim rubber and steel scrap obtained from recycled tires. It offers products, including crumb rubber, whole tire reclaim rubber, butyl reclaim rubber, steel cut wire shots, cut wire, and bead wire. The power generated from the windmill is sold to Bangalore Electricity Supply Company Limited and Jodhpur Vidhyut Vitran Nigam Limited.

Lead Reclaim and Rubber Products Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in the business of manufacturing of reclaim rubber products. The Company is a manufacturer of tire reclaim rubber, Butyl reclaim rubber granules, and crumb rubber powder. Its products include whole tire reclaim rubber, butyl tube reclaim rubber, and natural tube reclaim rubber. Its whole tire reclaim rubber is offered in four flagship grades: LEAD WTRHT (High Tensile), LEAD WTRHR (High Resilience), LEAD WTRSF (Super Fine) and LEAD WTR FINE. Its butyl tube reclaim rubber grades include LEAD BTR and LEAD BTRHT. Its natural tube reclaim rubber grades include LEAD NR and LEAD NRHT. It serves various industries, including tire industry, automotive industry, construction industry, footwear industry and other industries. It serves both local and international markets. Its international markets include England, United States, Australia, China, Argentina, Turkey, Sweden, Thailand, Sri Lanka, and Bangladesh.

KIOCL Ltd is an India-based company, which is engaged in the business of iron ore mining, beneficiation and production of pellets. The Company has diversified into operation and maintenance services and mineral exploration pertaining to its various core areas of expertise. The Company is also engaged in the field of iron, manganese, limestone, nickel, chromium, and others. The Company’s segments include Pellet and Pig Iron. Its iron ore pellets are used in steel production in both blast furnaces and direct reduction plants. The Company has the facilities to operate a 3.5 million tons per annum (MTPA) Iron-oxide Pellet Plant, Blast Furnace Unit to manufacture 2.16 lakh tons per annum Pig iron at Mangalore, Karnataka. It is a partner with the Ministry of Mines for promotional exploration projects and offers contractual exploration services to state governments, public sector companies and private entities. Its projects include Devadari Iron Ore Mine, and Solar Project.
