profile.company_profile: SAL Steel Limited is an India-based versatile steel, ferro alloys and power company. The Company operates near Kandla Port in the state of Gujarat in Western India. The Company’s product range consists of direct reduced iron (direct reduced iron/sponge iron), ferro alloys, iron ore pellets and various finished steel products. The Company also has a 40-megawatt (MW) plant, which generates power from a waste heat recovery boiler and fluidized bed combustion boiler. Its power generated is used for captive consumption and surplus power is sold to various customers.

Vraj Iron and Steel Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of iron and steel and power. The Company is involved in manufacturing of sponge iron, mild steel (M.S.) billets, and thermo mechanically treated (TMT) bars under the brand Vraj. It has two manufacturing units at Raipur and Bilaspur in Chhattisgarh. Its product includes Sponge Iron, TMT Bar, MS Billets and by-products, Dolochar, Pellet and Pig Iron, cater to a mix of customers that consists of industrial customers and end-users. Its MS billets are a semifinished casting product produced in a steel melting shop that needs to be further processed to transform them into a finished good. Sponge iron is the key raw material required to manufacture high quality steel. It has an installed capacity of producing over 1,20,000 metric tons annually and is in expansion mode. The Company has a capacity of five megawatts of power plant for its captive use.

Chaman Metallics Limited is an India-based company, which operates as a steel producer. The Company is primarily engaged in the business of manufacturing and selling direct reduced iron, which is sponge iron. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of iron and steel. Its segments include Sponge Iron, Ferro, and Power. Through its sponge iron business, the Company caters to the metallic requirements of steel producers in selected geographies. During the production of sponge iron, a solid waste is produced as a by-product called dolochar, which is used in power generation. It operates in various segments of steel, such as Sponge Iron, Ferro alloys, MS Ingots, and re-rolled products. Its manufacturing facility is located in Chandrapur, Maharashtra, spans over 63 acres, and features two rotary kilns with a combined annual capacity of approximately 72,000 metric tons (MT) for production of sponge iron.

Vaswani Industries Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in the business of manufacturing and trading of sponge iron, steel billets, HB wires, iron ore pellets and generation of power. The Company's segments include Iron & Steel, Power, Real Estate, and Agri Products. Its products include forging ingots/billets, sponge iron, and power. Its forging ingots include square and fluted types. It has a capacity of producing 6000 metric tons (MT) of forging quality, casting one heat of 10 metric tons of material. It also delivers different grades of carbon/ spring/ alloy steel products, such as EN-8, EN-9, EN-18, EN-19, C-45, Sup 9 and Sup 11. Its 03 Waste heat recovery boilers (WHRB), in the form of renewable energy from 100 TPD sponge iron kilns. The electricity generated in the captive power plant is used by the steel melting shop (SMS). Sponge iron is also known as direct reduced iron and it is the product of reducing iron oxide in the form of iron ore into metallic iron.

Shri Hare-Krishna Sponge Iron Limited is an India-based company. The Company is primarily engaged in the business of manufacturing and selling Sponge Iron. Its sponge iron is mainly used as a raw material for steel production in electric arc furnaces and induction furnaces. The Company's products include sponge iron, sections, and steel shots & grit. Its by-products are Dolochar and Iron Ore Fines. A sponge iron by - product called dolochar is produced, which is used in manufacturing steel billets, ingots and re-rolled products. It caters to the metallic requirements of steel producers in selected geographies. The Company’s manufacturing facility is located in Siltara - Raipur, Chhattisgarh and is spread across an area of around 13.45 acres of land with an annual production capacity of 30,000 metric tons.

DOMS Industries Limited is an India-based company. The Company is primarily engaged in the manufacturing, marketing, trading and distribution of school stationery and art materials. The Company’s products are primarily sold under the flagship brand DOMS, as well as through other sub-brands, such as C3, Amariz, FixyFix and ClapJoy. Its products consist of erasers, graphite pencil, sharpeners, acrylic colors, color pencils, oil pastels, plastic crayons, poster colors, sketch pens, synthetic brushes, tube colors, watercolors, wax crayons, drawing instruments, geometry boxes, diaries, notebooks, ball pens, chalks, correction pens, drawing pads, writing pad, marker pen, among others. The Company has approximately 11 manufacturing facilities located in Umbergaon, Gujarat and Bari Brahma, Jammu & Kashmir.

Navneet Education Limited is an India-based manufacturer of Maharashtra and Gujarat State board publication books and stationery products. The Company’s segments include Publication, Stationery, and Others. The Publication segment consists of supplementary books such as workbooks, guides, and question banks which are based on the latest prescribed syllabus by state education boards under the brand name of Vikas and Gala. The Stationery business consists of paper based and non-paper-based stationery under the brand names Navneet and Youva. It is also in the business of developing digital content and technology platforms for schools, teachers and students in India. Its businesses include state board curriculum, non-curriculum, Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), stationery, edtech (education technology) and others. Its CBSE business includes Indiannica, Rise, Companion and Grafalco. Its edtech business includes Navneet TopTech, which provides TopSchool, TopClass and TopScorer.

Flair Writing Industries Limited is an India-based company that manufactures and distributes writing instruments, stationery products, and other products. It has also diversified into producing houseware products and steel bottles. It sells its products under its brands, such as Flair, Hauser, Pierre Cardin, Zoox, Flair Creative, and Flair Houseware. It operates through a single segment, which is Writing Instruments and its Allies. The writing instruments products include ball pens, fountain pens, gel pens, and metal pens. Its stationery products include school kids’ stationery, pencils, correction pens, markers, gel crayons, and stationery kits. Its steel bottles and houseware products include casseroles, storage containers, serving solutions, and paper bins. It has the capacity to produce over 2.20 billion pieces of writing instruments across its 11 manufacturing plants. Its subsidiaries are Flair Writing Equipments Private Limited and Flair Cyrosil Industries Private Limited.

Kokuyo Camlin Limited is an India-based holding company, which is engaged in the business of manufacturing, trading, and selling of stationery. It manufactures art material, marker pens, inks, pencils, and others stationery products. The Company has diversified portfolio in office and school stationery segment comprising inks, colors, writing instruments, technical and drawing instruments, office stationery, markers, notebooks, scholasticism, and hobby art materials. Its paint supplies include artist acrylic colors, artist HD acrylics, artist watercolors, artist oil colors, student oil colors, premium poster colors, drawing inks, transparent photo colors, art powders, redi mix tempera colors, acrylic colors, and fluid acrylic colors. Its drawing materials include artist brush pens, art markers, artist soft pastels, artist oil pastels, drawing pencils, charcoals, drawing inks, and sketch books. The Company is the subsidiary of Kokuyo Co. Ltd.

Linc Limited is an India-based writing instrument manufacturer. The Company's product portfolio includes gel pens, ball pens, fountain pens, markers, mechanical pencils, files and folders. Its product categories include adhesive products, calculator, desktop supply, pencil, school stationery, stationery organizer, and writing instruments. It provides a range of products under the brands Stackoo, Linc, Pentonic, Uniball, and Deli. Its products include Linc TipTop, Linc Hi School Gel, Linc Smart OBG, Linc Ocean Gel, Linc Glycer, Linc Executive Gel, Linc Signetta, Linc Twinn, Linc Touch, and Pentonic. Its Pentonic products include Pentonic Ball Assorted, Pentonic BRT, Pentonic Ball, Pentonic Gum Stick, Pentonic Pencil, and others. Its Deli products include Deli A03893 sticky notes, Deli Desktop Calculator Black WM01120, Deli W9141 Dual Color Pen Holder 1 T, Deli W908 Mesh Pen Holder BLK 1 T, and others. Its Uniball products include Uniball Eye UB150, Uniball Click Gel, and others.

Sundaram Multi Pap Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in designing, manufacturing and marketing of paper stationery products. The Company covers the entire range from schools to colleges to office stationery. Its products include exercise notebooks, long books, note pads, drawing books, graph books for students of all ages, as well as office/corporate stationery products and printing, and writing & packaging paper. It has over 200 types of products, which are sold under the brand Sundaram. The Company, through its Edtech arm, E-Class, offers an online app, online portal and demo videos. E-class provides educational content for the students of Maharashtra State Board's 1st to 10th standards for all subjects, available in English, Marathi, Semi English, Hindi and Urdu medium as per the syllabus. Edzam, its online digital app and portal, improves the process of learning through the support of audio-visual content, assessment tool, analytical reports and others.

Indus Towers Limited is an India-based telecommunications (telecom) infrastructure provider. The Company deploys, owns, and manages telecom towers and communication structures. Its offerings include tower, power, space; smart cities; tower operations centers (TOC), and green technology. It deploys the passive physical infrastructure necessary to house the active equipment - the base transceiver station, transmission link, and microwave antenna. Its towers range from the traditional lattice type structure, such as the ground-based tower and rooftop tower or pole, to lightweight hybrid poles, monopoles or camouflaged towers that merge with the backdrop. Its towers are powered by either grid-sourced electricity or diesel generators. It acquires the requisite space from residential and commercial property owners for placing its passive infrastructure at various locations. It owns and operates approximately 219,736 towers with 368,588 co-locations.

profile.company_profile: HFCL Limited is an India-based global technology company. The Company delivers communication and networking products and solutions globally across the telecom, defense, and railways sectors. Its business segments include manufacturing of telecom products, executing turnkey contracts and providing services relating thereto. It offers a range of products and solutions for the telecom industry, which include optical fiber, optical fiber cables and cable accessories, point-to-point unlicensed band backhaul radio (UBR), indoor and outdoor wireless fidelity (Wi-Fi) five and six access points, Ethernet L2/L2+ managed switches, home mesh routers among others. It offers end-to-end solutions in the defense sector by designing customized defense communication products and establishing networks required by the armed forces for defense communication in India. It operates as designers of modern communication systems for metros, railways, and freight lines.

profile.company_profile: Pace Digitek Limited is an India-based company which is engaged in the business of infra power management, green energy and telecom, solar energy solutions, hybrid solutions and remote monitoring solutions, related operation and maintenance and product services infrastructure such as urban infrastructure, power and power transmission. Its segments include energy, telecom and others. The telecom segment provides end-to-end integrated solutions in the telecom tower infrastructure and optical fiber cables (OFC). The energy segment undertakes solar energy projects on a build, own and operate model, and solarization of telecom towers. Its telecom products include hybrid direct current (DC) power system, DC Power System, lithium battery, and others. The telecom segment is also engaged in product manufacturing of equipment for telecom industry, providing O&M services for telecom towers, and annual maintenance of OFC and other ancillary services and undertaking turnkey projects.

profile.company_profile: GTL Infrastructure Limited is an India-based company, which provides passive infrastructure on shared basis to telecom operators (Telcos) for hosting their active network components. The Company deploys, owns and manages telecom towers and communication structures that are shared by the wireless telecom operators. It enables telecom networks, including second-generation (2G), third generation (3G), fourth generation (4G) or fifth generation (5G), through its approximately 21,944 telecom towers located across all the 22 telecom circles. Its service offerings include infrastructure sharing and energy management. It enables telecom operators to host their active equipment at its sites by providing space in shelters and optimum heights for mounting antennae on towers. The Company delivers uninterrupted power on towers. It jointly works with its customers for demand management and clean energy solutions deployment. Its value additions include service assurance and customer relations.

profile.company_profile: Suyog Telematics Limited is an India-based telecommunications (telecom) infrastructure provider, engaged in installing, commissioning, and servicing poles, towers and optical fiber cable systems. It operates across approximately 15 telecom circles in India, and partners with telecom providers to host their telecommunications infrastructure in different geographies. It caters to telecom operators, Internet service providers, EPC companies, and government entities. It has a portfolio of over 6400 tenancies, encompassing Slum Sites, Flyovers, Skywalks, Foot over Bridges, Monorail, CCTV, Small Cell, and ULS (Urban Local Services) Sites. Its products and services include Telecom Towers, Operations and Maintenance Services, Rooftop Towers and Poles Sites, Fibre-to-the-Home (FTTH) Solutions, and Small Cell Infrastructure. It also offers CCTV Poles Sites and Slum Site Solutions. It also offers diesel generators, earth strips, batteries, electric power cable, fiber cable, and galvanized poles.

profile.company_profile: SAR Televenture Limited is an India-based network infrastructure company. The Company specializes in providing end-to-end telecom solutions, including Internet Service Provider (ISP) services, Infrastructure Provider (IP1) services, broadband, and enterprise connectivity solutions. It provides integrated solutions for residential and commercial buildings. Its solutions include tower infra, Fiber to the Home (FTTH) infra, intercom, smart prepaid meter, smart home automation, and video door phone. Its tower infra solutions include ground-based towers, monopoles, and cell on wheels. It offers Fiber to the x (FTTx) solutions, which provide subscribers with access to a variety of quad-play services, including data, voice, video, and IPTv. Its smart home automation solution features a wire-free control, real time alerts and easy scheduling. Its IP video intercom system helps builders and Resident Welfare Associations looking to enhance security and resident convenience in their societies.

profile.company_profile: Kore Digital Limited is an India-based company, which is a telecommunication infrastructure provider in Maharashtra. The Company is engaged primarily in the business of installing and commissioning of poles, towers and optical fiber cable (OFC) systems. It has installed over 600 pole-based cell sites along with roof top tower (RTT), ground base tower (GBT), and microwave backhaul installations. It owns and maintains an optical fiber cable infrastructure backbone spanning more than 700 kilometers (km) across Mumbai city and its surrounding districts of Maharashtra. It is focused towards providing passive communication infrastructure services mainly to the telecom network operators, broadband service operators and Internet service providers (ISPs) in Maharashtra. It offers project management services for duct and optic fiber cable laying, construction of transmission and telecom utilities, dark fiber leasing, optic fiber network construction, maintenance services, and turnkey solutions.

profile.company_profile: Rama Telecom Limited is an India-based technology driven engineering company. The Company is specialized in optical fiber providing end-to-end customized networking solutions in the telecom forefront. The Company is focused on laying duct and optic fiber for Telecommunication and railway companies and operation and maintenance of the cables. Its business model involves undertaking vendor projects where it undertakes cable and duct laying work for the telecom operators. Its business segments include the Railway Sector and Telecom Sector. The Company’s operations in the railway sector are centered on Device-to-Device (D2D) communication, addressing the sector's specialized requirements through precise planning and execution. Its telecom sector operations are supported by the robust demand for reliable communication services.
